parts.name: carriage_plate_left
parts.desc: Carriage bracket (left), v12.1: one of three identical rigid brackets cut from 6061 angle (2 x 1 x 1/4 in, 52 mm long). Leg A is screwed to the guide block z_carriage_left (four M3 x 10 into the block's own threads), leg B lies under the 2020 square's member sq_left (two M5 x 12 with washers up into T-nuts in its bottom slot, beside leg A). Rigid: the Z rails are aligned at assembly (rear rail the datum; left and right rails' screws left loose, the bed run up and down so they settle, then tightened top to bottom).

parts.model_source: HIWIN Corporation official CAD from configure.hiwin.com (collected for the owner, Instinct REQ-005 batch 6; checks in vendor_cad/staging/instinct_REQ-005/MANIFEST.md): the MGNR-12-R0300-H-M rail's section swept to 295 mm, holes per HIWIN's E rule (E = 10 mm at each end, 12 holes at 25 mm; HIWIN's own 245 mm file has exactly this layout)

parts.name: z_rail_right_screw_0
parts.desc: Socket head cap screw M3 x 8

parts.name: z_rail_right_screw_0_tnut
parts.desc: Drop-in T-nut M3 for 2020 slot 6: Misumi HNTAJ5-3 (post-assembly insertion short nut)
parts.model_source: re-made from the maker's dimensioned drawing: MISUMI USA 2019 catalogue (us.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2019/) p.2717, drawing of HNTAJ5: 10 (length), 8 (width), 3.2 (overall height), 2.4 (height of the wide body), 5.8 (width of the neck), M (thread, through). Part number table: M = 3, 4, 5. All six dimensions are in the model and nothing is guessed; the chamfers, the leaf spring and the countersink ring are drawn there without dimensions and are left out. Misumi's own STEP is still wanted (vendor_cad/inbox/TNUT-2020-M3.step)
